description: Edit a DAW session with a list of ops (regions, MIDI notes, sampler samples, tracks, faders/pans/mutes, plugins, tempo, markers, key, …): ids and current values from doseedo_get_session, op arguments from doseedo_edit_ops_reference. Live in Logic within seconds when sync.live_edits is true; otherwise stored and applied at next open. CONTRACT: every op is validated before anything is stored; a rejection carries a code — unknown_op / unknown_plugin (with did_you_mean), unknown_id (with the valid ids), duplicate_id, forbidden_group, read_only_key — and a reason. atomic (default true): one rejection → NOTHING stored, all rejections listed; atomic:false stores the good ops. RETRY: re-send a timed-out call with the SAME batch_key and it dedups (deduped:true); without batch_key a retry duplicates. Ops apply on the desktop one at a time in order, no per-batch undo — verify with doseedo_download_session (replay).

atomic.description: Default true: any rejected op means nothing is stored. Set false to store the valid ops and receive the rest as `rejected`.

batch_key.description: A stable id for THIS batch (e.g. "drumkit-build-1"). Same batch_key + same ops on a retry = the same client_op_ids = no duplicates. Always pass one for a build you might have to retry.

args.description: The op arguments (see the ops reference).

name: doseedo_edit_session
